a: createCursorSink recognizes its own write by string equality with `style.cursor`, which the browser hands back serialized, so an override set and then cleared without a base can stay on the element
brushRing answers a 24 px default ring for a negative, NaN or infinite radius instead of rejecting it or drawing it at its minimum size
b: A sink's override is never taken off when the browser serializes the cursor it wrote differently
The sink clears painted overrides it never set, unlike the element side
`placeCursorPath` with a negative scale mirrors arc endpoints but not their sweep flag
`brushRing(Infinity)` draws the default 24 px ring instead of refusing an infinite size
`runs()` takes `WEASEL_PBT_RUNS=Infinity` as an infinite run count
